title: Object-property organization across visual ROIs
scientific_question: On the declared public three-person panel, what cross-validated incremental relationship do animacy/size norms have with independently selected visual-ROI responses beyond fixed image-feature controls?
primary_outputs: Recomputed participant/ROI cross-validated variance contrasts from the permitted measurements and fixed model/fold definitions, including null or negative effects.

recording_contract.neural: Single-trial voxel response tables: rows voxels, columns trials; raw BOLD NIfTI alternative
recording_contract.labels: Actual BIDS event table inspected: onset,duration,trial_type,category_nr,exemplar_nr,test_image_nr,things_category_nr,things_exemplar_nr,response_time,file_path. Response table stimulus metadata include concept,image filename,trial type,run,session.
recording_contract.time_alignment: BIDS events onset in seconds; single-trial estimates aligned to stimulus metadata by trial index, which must be asserted when preparing packet.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 3 participant IDs,12 sessions each per archive; within-person native voxel spaces
recording_contract.evidence: Actual source manifest, first event-table rows, derivative sidecar, and pinned usage notebook. Figshare names match notebook; OpenNeuro derivative filenames differ.

primary.name: Absolute error in independently recomputed held-out incremental variance contrasts
primary.aggregation: Report each ROI/property contrast for every person, then equal-person average within each prespecified contrast; retain signed biological effect separately.
primary.rationale: For an all-public investigation, correctness is faithful recomputation, not rewarding a desired biological conclusion or overstating predictive generalization.

secondary: Signed property-minus-image-control variance gain and all fold denominators.
Independent review of uncertainty, nuisance adequacy and limitations; do not combine with arithmetic score until a reasoning rubric is qualified.

comparators.name: Image plus property model
comparators.procedure: Proposed independent augmented fit with training-only scaling/regularization.

comparators.name: Concept-label permutation
comparators.inputs: Whole concept groups, preserving within-concept rows
